name: Mitsui Chemicals, Inc.
summary: Mitsui Chemicals, Inc. manufacture and sell goods or services in life & healthcare solutions, mobility solutions, ICT solutions, and basic & green materials worldwide. The company offers vision care materials, nonwoven fabrics and personal care materials, agrochemicals, and oral care materials; and elastomers, performance and polypropylene compounds, and other materials.
